title: Q-IMPROVE-plus-seed-improve: Carry the improve loop in the seed so every new system improves itself from day one
body:

**Trigger:** improve --run
**Done check:** file:seed/scripts/improve.py
**Prediction:** external_referrals_7d > 83 within 168 h
**Status:** closed

Kind: plus. Baseline external_referrals_7d = 83. Settled 7 days after it closes: kept if external_referrals_7d rose, else replaced.

**Closing probe:** file:seed/scripts/improve.py


**Vacuous:** 2026-11-25T15:51:35Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-25T21:43:10Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-25T21:53:12Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: file:seed/scripts/improve.py
